```plato

    //==
    // # The standard unit cells
    //
    // The cells a lattice tool is expected to name, each dispatched on
    // `LatticeUnitCell` following the tree's constant idiom and read as
    // `LatticeUnitCell.OctetTruss`. Every one satisfies the periodicity
    // precondition in `lattices.types.plato`, so the tiling welds them without
    // a search.
    //
    // The number in each comment is the node's coordination number ONCE TILED —
    // how many struts meet at it in the infinite lattice, which is not the
    // number of struts touching it inside one cell. `NodeValences` recomputes it
    // from any cell.

    // The simple cubic cell: the eight cube corners joined by the twelve cube
    // edges. Coordination 6, and bending-dominated — the softest of the cells
    // here, because nothing triangulates its square faces.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_crystal_system)
    SimpleCubic(_: LatticeUnitCell): LatticeUnitCell
        => LatticeUnitCell(LatticeUnitCell.CubeCorners, LatticeUnitCell.CubeEdges);
```
